messages:
Priya: handing off primary to @Ben — quick summary: noticed KV cache p99 spike ~800ms on embeddings route earlier this morning. Warm restarts started on pool-2, eviction job kicked. Incidentbot paged earlier (INC-4721). Details & links below.

oncall-bot: Incident opened: KV_CACHE_P99_HIGH (INC-4721). Pager sent to oncall. Affected service: embeddings-route (pool-2). Severity: potential-customer-impact. Pager link: https://pager.redwood/incidents/INC-4721

Ben: taking primary now. thanks Priya. what’s the current mitigation state? any confirmed customer errors?

Priya: mitigation = rolling warm restart of workers in pool-2, stepped 10% at a time. Cache eviction job running on edge nodes with prefix filter for embeddings. Console shows no wide customer degradation yet; one tenant saw errors tick from 0 -> 0.2% but not steady. console: https://console.redwood/metrics/embeddings/p99

Ben: ok. i'll monitor metrics and increase canary if stable. runbook i'm following: https://confluence.redwood/runbooks/kv-cache-thrash. quick cmds i'm running: 
```bash
kubectl -n infra rollout restart deploy/kv-worker-pool-2
redwoodctl cache evict --scope=pool-2 --prefix=embedding
```

Luis: heads-up — last month we saw this pattern tied to a quantized model shard resync. check the deployment tag `model-embed-v2-quant` on pool-2. if it's that, prefer rollback vs full restart.

Ben: good call. checking… tag present on 2/6 nodes. if we rollback, we'll canary 1 node first. recommended rollback cmd: `redwoodctl model rollback model-embed-v2-quant --nodes=1`

Tara: i'll draft customer comms just in case. current impact is low, but if errors cross 1% i'll escalate to ops comms. draft template: https://docs.redwood/comm-templates/kv-cache-err

Ben: status update — after first 10% warm restart, p99 dropped ~40% in canary. moving to 30% now. metrics: p99 820ms -> 300ms. no new errors in the last 5m. will watch for 15m.

oncall-bot: INC-4721 update: autoscaler notifications pending. reminder scheduled in 10m if KPIs not recovered.

Priya: Ben — handoff checklist for you: - confirm KV cache ops green in console - verify autoscaler not suppressed/disabled - ensure cache eviction job finished - leave a short note in INC-4721 with steps & timestamps. pass secondary to Luis after 30m if stable.

Ben: copy that. i'll keep primary. if latency resurges, plan is rollback 1 node first: `redwoodctl deploy rollback model-embed-v2-quant --nodes=1`. i'll also bump logging for cache miss ratio.

Luis: i'm standby as secondary. if you need me to run the rollback or coordinate dedicated-pool restarts, i can take it. leaving an extra runbook pointer: https://runbooks.redwood/ops/kv-cache-fast-remedy

Priya: :thumbsup: handing off complete. i'm off now — please add a couple lines to the ticket summarizing what ran and when.

Ben: acknowledged. adding notes to INC-4721 now and will ping @oncall-manager if we cross customer-impact threshold.
